developer.name: Copilot Agent and Tools Health Check

name.full: Agent and Tools Health Check for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Read-only health check of agents, tools, agent identities and blueprints
description.full: Checks Copilot agents and tools, Entra agent identities, agent identity blueprints and Conditional Access for agents: group-scoped access, sponsors and owners, least privilege, clear names and descriptions, and stale items. Scores each area and explains how to fix each problem. Reads Entra through the Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise. Read-only.

agentConnectors.description: Read-only Microsoft Graph calls for Microsoft Entra agent identities, blueprints, permissions, sign-in activity, groups, users and Conditional Access, as the signed-in admin.
